H01.bounded_claim: HTTP public model: standard/custom methods and invalid tokens

H02.bounded_claim: HTTP headers: case-insensitive names, conflict rejection, opaque values and immutable snapshots

H03.bounded_claim: HTTP URLs: base path, reserved/unicode segments, traversal, invalid schemes/userinfo/fragments and encoding

H04.bounded_claim: HTTP queries: ordered/repeated names and absent/nil/empty values

H05.bounded_claim: HTTP raw input: same validation/origin/effective ports and typed parity

H06.bounded_claim: HTTP body: none versus empty Data, UTF-8, JSON strategies/null/float/formatting

H07.bounded_claim: HTTP request policy: header/Content-Type precedence, method preservation, GET/HEAD bodies and managed fields

H08.bounded_claim: HTTP rejection: streams/malformed input rejected; safe failure does not poison later requests

H09.bounded_claim: HTTP response: JSON/media types, status-first interpretation, no invented empty JSON model

H10.bounded_claim: HTTP response: explicit 204/HEAD empty; raw Data; strict UTF-8/charset; invalid/non-HTTP response

H11.bounded_claim: HTTP status: 2xx and explicit nonempty valid exceptions; typed/raw strategy parity

H12.bounded_claim: HTTP pipeline: typed/raw JSON/Data/text/empty, status/content-type ordering and structured errors

H13.bounded_claim: HTTP failures: no retry/error payload disclosure; safe transport identity; timeout distinct from unexplained cancellation

H14.bounded_claim: HTTP acceptance: public POST parity, encoding failure/no send, bad UTF-8, no HTTP replay and origin/credential boundaries

L01.bounded_claim: Lifecycle snapshots: defaults/overrides, finite positive limits and concurrent immutable snapshots

L02.bounded_claim: Lifecycle codecs: per-operation encoding and decoding without shared policy/payload

L03.bounded_claim: Lifecycle codecs: independent decoders and cancellation around synchronous decoding

L04.bounded_claim: Lifecycle ownership: session reuse/snapshot, compatible injection and per-session concurrent work

L05.bounded_claim: Lifecycle budget: 30/60 defaults, raw/typed overrides and joined watchdog cleanup

L06.bounded_claim: Lifecycle cancellation: before/during I/O and per-call isolation

L07.bounded_claim: Lifecycle elapsed time: budget covers options/encoding/awaited hooks/decoding; no late success

L08.bounded_claim: Lifecycle terminal arbitration: system/total timeout identity, first interruption, selected completion, bounded long sleeps

L09.bounded_claim: Lifecycle shutdown: idempotence/admission, joined finalization, shutdown waiters retain cleanup ownership

L10.bounded_claim: Lifecycle concurrency: first cause/result retained, independent snapshots/codecs and cleanup on failures

L11.bounded_claim: Lifecycle ownership: owned closure and unrelated borrowed-session activity survives

L12.bounded_claim: Lifecycle system limits: resource timeout separate; strict storage/connectivity defaults

S01.bounded_claim: Security origins: HTTPS default, canonical loopback permission, lookalike/LAN rejection and no HTTP secrets

S02.bounded_claim: Security redirects: GET/HEAD, same effective origin, at most five hops, no mutation/downgrade/cross-origin replay

S03.bounded_claim: Security native redirect: denied destination receives no request; bounded success/loop/hop failure; task-only terminal cancellation

S04.bounded_claim: Security challenge policy: system-handling disposition, no fallback or proposed credentials; native TLS acceptance still OPEN

S05.bounded_claim: Security injection: strict/app-managed storage compatibility, background/delegate/global-header rejection

S06.bounded_claim: Security strict storage: owned/borrowed cookie/cache wire probes and owned Basic challenge control

S07.bounded_claim: Security app-managed scope: no active stores on HTTP, no foreign cookies/cache policy inheritance

S08.bounded_claim: Security provider: minimal context, validation/conflicts/explicit precedence and opt-out

S09.bounded_claim: Security provider boundaries: HTTP/foreign origins never inherit auth; cancellation/timeout/cleanup; no refresh/replay

S10.bounded_claim: Security account isolation: independent bindings and cancellation

S11.bounded_claim: Security diagnostics: canaries across boundaries; fixed method allowlist; on/off preserves results; do not re-read user values

S12.bounded_claim: Security diagnostic lifecycle: one safe event, joined cleanup, sink latency and selected terminal cause

S13.bounded_claim: Security diagnostic concurrency: account canaries and unknown errors never formatted

P01.bounded_claim: Public boundary: external import without @testable, consumer injection, formats, auth, diagnostics, profile and shutdown

C01.bounded_claim: Manifest/name/product/platform minima, Swift mode and no external dependencies

C02.bounded_claim: All four builds and five runtime results, exact tools/destinations

C03.bounded_claim: No success for empty/failed/skipped/expected-failure or missing runtime results

C04.bounded_claim: Real DocC/source controls and mandatory aggregate, no dummy green path

C05.bounded_claim: Least privilege and standard-runner cost/resource bounds

C07.bounded_claim: Minimum OS, physical devices, native trust and release quality

quality_disposition: No newly established product defect or justified generic refactor; retain exact native/platform and residual-risk limits.
